classification.difficultyReason: Read the rectangle's labelled dimensions, account for both pairs of equal sides and reverse the perimeter equation to find b.

content.prompt: Determine the breadth of this rectangle if the perimeter is 72.7 cm.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 17 rectangle below the prompt on the left
spec.description: Unfilled horizontal rectangle with matching single ticks on its top and bottom edges, matching double ticks on its left and right edges, b cm above the top edge and 4 cm beside the left edge.
spec.mathematics: Opposite sides of the rectangle are equal, so its perimeter is b + 4 + b + 4 centimetres. Drawing proportions follow the source and are not additional measurements.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied side labels and equality ticks are visible; the equation and solved breadth belong to the answer.

answer.worked:
Let $b$ be the breadth in centimetres.
$$\begin{align*}
b+4+b+4&=72.7\\
2b+8&=72.7\\
2b&=64.7\\
b&=32.35
\end{align*}$$
The breadth is $32.35\text{ cm}$.
Check: $2(32.35)+2(4)=72.7\text{ cm}$.
